$comment: Shape documentation only. The live set is supplied at composition time by
the COMPOSITION_EXTENSIONS repository variable, so the host builds and runs
identically with a different set or with none, and adding an extension
never edits the host. A list committed here would make this file the thing
that has to change, which is the coupling the variable exists to avoid.
'repository' and 'workflow' are the trust declaration: the host verifies
each signature against the identity built from them, so an extension cannot
widen who may sign for it by editing its own repository. Listing an
extension grants nothing on its own -- each is still admitted independently,
